name: Hill (Steep Grade)
spec: yellow diamond with a black truck on a downward slope and legend 8%
meaning: A steep downhill ahead; shift to a lower gear and control speed.

snippets.back: Do not pass near a hill or curve when the view ahead is insufficient.
Narrow hilly or wooded roads hide blind pockets where another car may be only feet away before you see it, so use extra caution and tap the horn on dangerous curves.
The guide lists an obstructed view near a steep hill, sharp curve, or narrow-valley exit among situations for a horn warning.
Do not pass when approaching a curve or a hilltop where you cannot see far enough ahead to know passing is safe.
For downhill parking, turn the front wheels toward the curb; for uphill parking, turn them away from it.
The law forbids coasting downhill with the transmission in neutral.
Expect a truck or an underpowered vehicle to lose speed on a long or steep hill.
A solid line on your side forbids passing, and a curve or hilltop that hides the road ahead forbids it too; the manual lists them as separate conditions.

result.summary: No snippet describes a Hill/Steep Grade sign shape/color/legend or states its warning meaning; snippets only give general hill driving rules.
